name: Jane Eyre
equipment: A copy of the book (public domain -- free from Project Gutenberg or Standard Ebooks)
instructions: Jane Eyre was written by Charlotte Brontë, first published in 1847.
Follows orphaned Jane from a harsh childhood through her role as governess at Thornfield Hall -- notable for its strong first-person female narrator and moral independence.
Discussion prompt: Independence is one of the novel's central threads -- note a passage where you saw it most clearly.
